name: Gemini Notebooks browsable as web buckets, their artifacts in L-Space
asks: by the end of the day, we should be able to browse our Gemini notebooks as if they were standard web buckets, so that we can start getting the generated artifacts out of gemini notebook, into our own storage systems, in the same graph as our other knowledge, embeddable on l-space pages, etc.

board-opening.need: by the end of the day, we should be able to browse our Gemini notebooks as if they were standard web buckets, so that we can start getting the generated artifacts out of gemini notebook, into our own storage systems, in the same graph as our other knowledge, embeddable on l-space pages, etc.

requirements.says: The Gemini Notebook service shall present each notebook as a bucket browsable through a standard web-bucket interface.
The Gemini Notebook service shall copy the artifacts a notebook generates into the Group's own storage.
requirements.rationale: [lRdMGdPDLMww]: 'getting the generated artifacts out of gemini notebook, into our own storage systems'.

requirements.says: The Group's storage shall hold each copied artifact in the same graph as the Group's other knowledge.

requirements.rationale: [lRdMGdPDLMww]: 'our ability to store multimedia in L-Space'.

requirements.says: An L-Space page shall embed the stored artifacts.
The Group's records, interfaces and code shall name the product Gemini Notebook and not NotebookLM.
requirements.rationale: [VIpcwFBO_OZM]: 'We need to convert all NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook to keep up with Google's branding changes.'

conditions.says: A notebook of the Group listed through the bucket interface returns its artifacts.
An artifact generated yesterday is found in the Group's storage graph and embedded on an L-Space page.
A search of the Group's current records, interfaces and code finds no 'NotebookLM' outside historical citations.

board-opening.context: Held already: the section `gemini-notebook-services-section` (about 250 files mention Gemini Notebook across the house) and `notebooklm-micro-enterprise.json` (2026-07-17; its title and cells keep the old name as history). Remaining 'NotebookLM' occurrences are in that section's own records and in the public-education README; this record asks that they be converted except where they cite the old name as history. The Founder's answers on 2026-09-26 to three of the agent's questions (the second 'Not yet', the first 'Yes') are not recoverable without the questions, which are not in the utterance record.
